title: The Open Book Project — Input-Output Interface and Modes of Transfer

access.notes: Free Chapter 20; §§20.5–20.7 explain programmed/polled I/O vs interrupt-driven I/O. This is conceptual background only: OEE SEF1's eight-bit machine has no interrupts.

verification.basis: Public Open Book Project chapter 20 §§20.5 (Modes of Data Transfer), 20.6 (Programmed I/O), 20.7 (Interrupt-initiated I/O) were inspected on 2026-11-21; chapter contrasts CPU polling and device interrupt notification.
